ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** with VoiceOver, then TalkBack, open an area's card and swipe through "What's here"; then look at a tile on a 320 pt wide phone with all eight kinds. **Expect:** "Sights" is read as a heading, then its line and its five kinds, then "Local life" as a heading and its three; the tile's icons stay one row, the Local life ones set apart by a wider space, the last inside the tile. (SG2, SG3)
